Name: lead_aware_gated_fusion
Title: Lead-Aware Gated Fusion for ECG Arrhythmia Classification
Experiment: Split the 34 ECG features into two lead-specific branches, encode each branch with a small MLP, and learn a soft gate that fuses the two branch embeddings before classification. Compare the baseline flat MLP against the gated fusion model using macro-F1, balanced accuracy, and class-wise recall. Visualize the learned gate values to show whether the model relies more on one lead for specific arrhythmia classes.

Name: class_balanced_focal_loss
Title: Class-Balanced Focal Loss for Imbalanced ECG Arrhythmia Prediction
Experiment: Replace the baseline class-weighted cross entropy with a focal-style objective that combines class-balanced weights and hard-example focusing. Keep the model architecture fixed and compare performance on minority arrhythmia classes, macro-F1, and calibration error. Run an ablation over focal gamma values and show whether the improved loss helps under strong label imbalance.

Name: feature_group_dropout
Title: Feature-Group Dropout for Robust ECG Diagnosis
Experiment: Introduce a structured dropout scheme that randomly masks one ECG feature group during training to encourage robustness and reduce lead dependence. Compare against the flat baseline and measure whether feature-group dropout improves balanced accuracy, minority recall, and test stability across seeds. Analyze whether the model becomes less sensitive to either lead block.
